raw_response: {"diagnosis": "84 raw_transactions rows are in EUR, but silver_transactions passes amount through unchanged, so gold totals mix EUR and USD values. raw_fx_rates holds a rate_to_usd for EUR (1.25), so amounts can be converted to USD in the silver step.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": ["CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW fx_latest AS SELECT currency, rate_to_usd FROM (SELECT currency, rate_to_usd, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY as_of DESC) AS rn FROM raw_fx_rates) WHERE rn = 1"], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(round(t.amount * f.rate_to_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t LEFT JOIN fx_latest f ON t.currency = f.currency WHERE t.status = 'POSTED'"}}
